name: Test: generic game method cost (C#)
author: test
summary: Measures every compiled instance of the read-only generic game methods: first call, hot call and allocation, against non-generic baselines.
description: Build with tools/tests/build-cs.sh csgenericsperf. In the world, logs 'csgenericsperf case=<group>/<name> cold_us=.. hot_ns=.. min_ns=.. alloc_b=.. n=..' per case and 'csgenericsperf END cases=N errors=M'.
